newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB to announce new president at 0200 GMT.
newsitem.headline: DKB to announce new president at 0200 GMT.

text.p: Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it will name a new president at 11 a.m. (0200 GMT).
A bank spokesman said earlier that the bank is likely to appoint its current managing director Katsuyuki Sugita to the post.
On May 23, DKB announced that its president Katsuhiko Kondo and chairman Tadashi Okuda would step down at the end of June to take the blame for the bank's loans to a corporate racketeer.

Present and former DKB officials have been arrested on suspicion of giving 11.78 billion yen in uncollateralised loans, via a DKB affiliate, to Kojin Building Co, a realtor run by the racketeer Ryuichi Koike's younger brother.
The loans, extended from July 1994 to September 1996, are suspected of violating Japan's Commercial Code.
